# Joe's Unique Creations
> Local custom apparel and promotional printing business in Glenside, Pennsylvania, specializing in DTF printing and custom T-shirts.

## Canonical website
- https://joesuniquecreationspa.com/

## Business facts
- Business: Joe's Unique Creations
- Location: 745 Edge Hill Road, Glenside, PA 19038
- Phone: 610-368-0865
- Email: joesuniquecreations19038@gmail.com
- Primary service: DTF custom apparel printing
- Other services: custom hoodies, ready-to-press DTF transfers, sublimation, promotional products, custom stickers and labels, signs, personalized gifts
- Service area: Glenside, Montgomery County, and the greater Philadelphia area
- Local press: Featured by Glenside Local on September 30, 2026: https://glensidelocal.com/meet-joe-martin-owner-of-joes-unique-creations-a-glenside-based-custom-apparel-and-printing-shop/
- Same-day service: qualifying orders of 12 shirts or fewer submitted by 10:00 AM may be completed the same day, subject to garment availability, ready/approved artwork, job complexity, and production capacity
